name: indian-business-ops-skills
note: Two kinds of eval. graded_by 'script' items are checked automatically by run_deterministic.py against the bundled helpers (the computational core). graded_by 'llm' items are judgement questions for the full with-skill vs without-skill benchmark; see README.md.

evals.note: illustrative GSTIN with wrong check digit

evals.prompt: We're paying a freelance graphic designer ₹80,000 for a logo. Do we deduct TDS and under which section?
evals.expected: Section 194J (professional fees), standard rate; confirm current rate/threshold on the portal.

evals.prompt: Monthly office rent is ₹60,000 to the landlord. TDS?
evals.expected: Section 194I (rent), building rate; threshold applies — verify current figures.

evals.prompt: We paid a civil contractor ₹5,00,000 for office fit-out. Which TDS section and what changes the rate?
evals.expected: Section 194C; rate differs individual/HUF vs others; check PAN (206AA) and filing status (206AB).

evals.prompt: We pay a US-based consultant. Can we use 194J?
evals.expected: No — payments to non-residents fall under section 195, with surcharge/cess and possible DTAA relief (15CA/15CB); not a resident 194 section.

evals.prompt: We're in Maharashtra selling to a customer in Gujarat. CGST+SGST or IGST?
evals.expected: Inter-state → IGST, because place of supply is a different state.

evals.prompt: Both we and our customer are in Karnataka. Which taxes on the invoice?
Do we need to generate an e-invoice (IRN/QR)?
evals.expected: Depends on aggregate turnover crossing the notified e-invoice threshold; applies to B2B/exports/credit-debit notes, not B2C. Confirm current threshold on the portal.

evals.prompt: Turnover is about ₹2 crore. Do we file GST monthly or quarterly?
evals.expected: Eligible for QRMP (quarterly returns, monthly payment) if at/under the turnover limit; GSTR-1/3B quarterly, tax paid monthly. Verify the current limit.

evals.prompt: We're registered under the composition scheme. Do we issue a tax invoice?
evals.expected: No — a composition dealer issues a bill of supply and cannot charge GST the normal way.

evals.prompt: Can we claim input tax credit on a team lunch at a restaurant?
evals.expected: Generally blocked under section 17(5) (food and beverages), unless used to make an outward taxable supply of the same category or obligatory under law.

evals.prompt: We're shipping goods worth ₹80,000 interstate by road. e-way bill?
evals.expected: Likely yes above the consignment-value threshold; Part A + Part B; thresholds/exemptions vary by state — verify.

evals.prompt: Solo founder, wants limited liability and plans to raise VC later. Proprietorship, LLP or Pvt Ltd?
evals.expected: Private Limited — suits funding/ESOPs/investors despite higher compliance; proprietorship has unlimited liability and can't raise equity.

evals.prompt: Is Professional Tax the same across India?
evals.expected: No — PT is a state tax; it doesn't exist in some states and slabs/periodicity differ by state. Ask which state and confirm that state's schedule.
